

```{r KHmodel, echo=FALSE}
Da_TARGET <- c(0.1/100, 0.2/100, 0.5/100)*Hs*100 # [cm]
Ts_TARGET <- TS[level=="mean"]$Ts
TR_TARGET <- c(200,500,1000,5000,2500,10000)
po_TARGET <- c(0.05,0.10,0.16,0.50,"mean",0.84,0.90,0.95)
Vs30_TARGET <- 1000
DT <- gmdp::buildTable.Kmax(.x = GMDP$UHSTable, Vs30o = Vs30_TARGET, Tso = Ts_TARGET, Dao = Da_TARGET, po = po_TARGET, TRo = TR_TARGET)
AUX <- NULL
LT1 <- DT[p==0.16,.(TR,"16%"=Kmax,Vs30,Da)]
LT2 <- DT[p==0.84,.(TR,"84%"=Kmax,Vs30,Da)]
AUX <- LT1[LT2,on=.(TR,Vs30,Da)]
LT<- DT[p=="mean",.(TR,"mean"=Kmax,Vs30,Da)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR,Vs30,Da)]
LT <- DT[p==0.50,.(TR,"50%"=Kmax,Vs30,Da)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR,Vs30,Da)]
LT<- DT[p==0.05,.(TR,"5%"=Kmax,Vs30,Da)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR,Vs30,Da)]
LT <- DT[p==0.95,.(TR,"95%"=Kmax,Vs30,Da)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR,Vs30,Da)]
LT <- DT[p==0.10,.(TR,"10%"=Kmax,Vs30,Da)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR,Vs30,Da)]
LT <- DT[p==0.90,.(TR,"90%"=Kmax,Vs30,Da)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR,Vs30,Da)]
setcolorder(AUX,neworder = c("TR","Da","Vs30","5%","10%","16%","50%","mean","84%","90%","95%")) 
DT.Kmax <- AUX


AUX <- NULL
LT1 <- DT[p==0.16,.(TR,"16%"=Kh,Vs30,Da)]
LT2 <- DT[p==0.84,.(TR,"84%"=Kh,Vs30,Da)]
AUX <- LT1[LT2,on=.(TR,Vs30,Da)]
LT<- DT[p=="mean",.(TR,"mean"=Kh,Vs30,Da)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR,Vs30,Da)]
LT <- DT[p==0.50,.(TR,"50%"=Kh,Vs30,Da)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR,Vs30,Da)]
LT<- DT[p==0.05,.(TR,"5%"=Kh,Vs30,Da)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR,Vs30,Da)]
LT <- DT[p==0.95,.(TR,"95%"=Kh,Vs30,Da)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR,Vs30,Da)]
LT <- DT[p==0.10,.(TR,"10%"=Kh,Vs30,Da)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR,Vs30,Da)]
LT <- DT[p==0.90,.(TR,"90%"=Kh,Vs30,Da)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR,Vs30,Da)]
setcolorder(AUX,neworder = c("TR","Da","Vs30","5%","10%","16%","50%","mean","84%","90%","95%")) 
DT.Kh <- AUX

rm(LT1,LT2,AUX,LT)
```

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| label: tbl-Kh
#| tbl-cap: "Seismic Coefficients (mean values) for different service levels and performance levels, assuming local site conditions with Vs30=1000 m/s - Kmax[g]" 
TBL <- DT[p=="mean" & Vs30 ==Vs30_TARGET]
TBL |> buildTable(library="gt") 
```

#### Da=0.5% Hs
```{r include=TRUE}
#| label: tbl-KH_05
#| tbl-cap: "Seismic Coefficients (Kmax[g]) for different service levels, assuming local site conditions with Vs30=1000 m/s and residual deformations of 0.5% Hs." 
#| 
TBL <- DT.Kmax[Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & Da==7.5]
TBL |> buildTable(library="gt") |> 
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c("5%","10%","16%","50%","mean","84%","90%","95%"),decimals = 3) 
```
